chunks.heading: Love
chunks.notes: Opens with a rhetorical question ("Why would I?") and builds an anaphoric catalog of conditioned love, grounded in a mother whose hugs are described as snares.

chunks.heading: Love
chunks.notes: Continues the anaphoric "I was conditioned to love my father" catalog through the moat/self-wounding image and closes with an explicit aphoristic statement about love as an unapproachable shadow.
